Messages.Author: Shockwave
Messages.Body:
Why yes, this is a weapons-grade Jozxyqk question, and yes, I am a bad person.

I have Lisandro Giovanni in play. I use his special to count him as a Samedi, and play Houngan onto him, which I believe is possible because he's a Samedi for the duration of playing this card.

The following turn, I am under the impression he cannot gain 1 Blood, because he's no longer a Samedi, but back to being a Giovanni, but may he tap for 'an additional blood' on top of the zero he receives for being a Samedi.

Rationale: The clause 'and he may' is not phrased 'And this Samedi may' like the other two effects of the card.

Houngan -- Type: Master -- Clan: Samedi -- Cost: 1 pool
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready Samedi you control. During your untap phase, this Samedi gains 1 blood from the bank, and he or she may tap to gain an additional blood. Any other Samedi may move this card to himself or herself as a +1 stealth action.

Here we go again....
Dave Knowles (Advanced)
Sabbat Bishop of Manchester

Messages.Body:
> Shockwave wrote:
> Why yes, this is a weapons-grade Jozxyqk question, and yes, I am a bad person.
>
> I have Lisandro Giovanni in play. I use his special to count him as a Samedi, and play Houngan onto him, which I believe is possible because he's a Samedi for the duration of playing this card.
>
> The following turn, I am under the impression he cannot gain 1 Blood, because he's no longer a Samedi, but back to being a Giovanni, but may he tap for 'an additional blood' on top of the zero he receives for being a Samedi.
>
> Rationale: The clause 'and he may' is not phrased 'And this Samedi may' like the other two effects of the card.
>
> Houngan -- Type: Master -- Clan: Samedi -- Cost: 1 pool
> Unique master.
> Put this card on a ready Samedi you control. During your untap phase, this Samedi gains 1 blood from the bank, and he or she may tap to gain an additional blood. Any other Samedi may move this card to himself or herself as a +1 stealth action.
>
That's grammar.
"he" refers to "this Samedi", not to "this vampire" (not written on the card).
Therefore, Lisandro indeed cannot gain blood at all with Houngan (unless he's Samedi)

First, Coroner's Contract doesn't require Samedi so it won't see Lisandro as Samedi at any point. Second, Lisandro needs to be in play to have his special to work. Uncontrolled vampires can't use their special text, so uncontrolled Lisandro is just 9 cap Giovanni.

Marko, Prince of Helsinki
